name: Applicant Name
whatItMeans: The full legal name of the person or entity applying for the new electricity connection.
whatToEnter: Enter your full name as appearing on your official government-issued ID.

name: Father's/Spouse's Name
whatItMeans: The name of the applicant's father or spouse for official record and identification purposes.
whatToEnter: Enter the full name of your father or spouse.

name: Contact Number
whatItMeans: The primary mobile number of the applicant for receiving updates and verification calls.

name: Email ID
whatItMeans: The electronic mail address of the applicant for digital communication and billing.
whatToEnter: Enter your current and active email address.

name: Service Connection Address
whatItMeans: The exact physical location where the new electricity connection is required.
whatToEnter: Enter the complete postal address including plot number, street, locality, landmark, and pincode.

name: Category of Connection
whatItMeans: The tariff category under which electricity will be consumed (e.g., Domestic, Commercial, Industrial).
whatToEnter: Select the appropriate category for your electricity usage.

name: Requested Load (kW/HP)
whatItMeans: The total electrical load capacity requested for the new connection.
whatToEnter: Enter the required load in kilowatts (kW) or horsepower (HP) based on your appliance requirements.

name: Proof of Identity
whatItMeans: An official government document verifying the identity of the applicant.
whatToEnter: Provide details and upload a copy of a valid ID proof such as Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, or PAN Card.

name: Proof of Ownership / Occupancy
whatItMeans: A legal document establishing the applicant's ownership or lawful occupancy of the premises.
whatToEnter: Provide details and upload a copy of the property tax receipt, sale deed, or valid rent agreement.
